meta.parties: Jeyasingham, R. v. De Almedia, M

rules.statement: Where different parts of a deed are inconsistent with each other, effect ought to be given to that part which is calculated to carry into effect the real intention of the parties, and that part which would defeat it should be rejected.
rules.supporting_quote: "where different parts of a deed are inconsistent with each other, effect ought to be given to that part which is calculated to carry into effect the real intention of the parties, and that part which would defeat it should be rejected."
